component.name: AppHeader
component.description: A full-width top navigation bar with the logo, a search field, navigation links and the user menu.

useWhen: Every page that requires global navigation and search

donts.case: Using AppHeader inside a page section or Card
donts.because: AppHeader is a full-width page-level organism; nesting it breaks its width and positioning semantics.
donts.instead: Place AppHeader at the root layout level, above the page content container.
